allegiances.name: Allegiance: Catachan Jungle Fighters

restrictions.printed: You may not take the Tempestus Drop Force Rite of War.

If your army is not using the Infantry Company Rite of War (See Rites of War section) you do not gain the first listed benefit under the Rite of War.

allegiances.name: Allegiance: Elysian Drop Troops

restrictions.printed: You may not take the Tempestus Drop Force Rite of War.

game_time: During the first battle round, all Elysian Drop Troops Infantry units gain a 4+ Cover Save. In addition, half of your units in reserve that have the Elysian Drop Troops Keyword may arrive during the first battle round.
If your army is not using the Airborne Company Rite of War (See Rites of War section) you do not gain the first listed benefit under the Rite of War.

allegiances.name: Allegiance: Mordian Iron Guard

restrictions.printed: Your army must include at least 1 unit of Mordian Honour Guard.

game_time: Mordian Iron Guard Infantry units that have all models in the unit in base contact with each other, gain the Stubborn special rule.

allegiances.name: Allegiance: Savlar Chem Dogs

benefits.printed: All units in your army gain the Expendable Keyword.

game_time: Savlar Chem Dogs units only make Panic tests in the Shooting Phase after suffering 50% casualties.

rites_of_war.name: Infantry Company
rites_of_war.text:
Restrictions

- Your army must include at least 2 Infantry Section.
- Your army must include at least 1 Company Command Squad.
- Your army must include more Infantry type units than any other type.

Benefit

- You may replace Guardsmen Squads with Veteran Squads in any Infantry Section you include in your army.
- Guardsmen Squads in your army may purchase Krak Grenade for all models in the unit for 10pts.
- Veteran Squads in your army may purchase a Breacher Charge for all models in the unit for 10pts.

rites_of_war.name: Mechanized Company
rites_of_war.text:
Restrictions

- Your army must include at least 1 Recon Section.
- All Infantry type units in your army must begin the game in a Transport or in reserves.
- Your army must include at least 2 Hippogriff AFV or Sentinels.

Benefit

- You may replace Rough Riders with Taurox Armoured Cars in any Recon Section you include in your army.
- You may field Salamander Scout Tank units with the Salamander Command option as HQ choices.
- You gain access to the Combined Fire Order below.

Benefit

- You may field Artillery Section as Troops choices but it gains the Support Squad special rule.

rites_of_war.name: Armoured Company
rites_of_war.text:
Restrictions

- Your army must include at least 1 Tank Section.
- Your army must include at least 1 Leman Russ Tank Commander or Rogal Dorn Heavy Tank Commander.
- Your warlord must have the Vehicle type.

Benefit

- You may field Tank Sections as Elites choices.
- You may field 1 Baneblade Super Heavy Battle Tank as a Heavy Support choice.
- You gain access to the Take Aim! Order (see below)

rites_of_war.name: Airborne Company
rites_of_war.text:
Restrictions

- Your army must include at least 1 Air Section.
- At least half the Infantry units in your army may not begin the game on the battlefield and must begin the game in reserves or embarked in a Transport unless they have the Scout or Infiltrate special rules.
- You may not field the following units:
    - Tank keyword units.
    - Artillery Keyword.
    - Ogryn Squad unit.
    - Ratling Squad units.
    - Rough Rider units.

Benefit

- You may field Air Sections as Heavy Support choices.
- Any Infantry, Bike, Vehicle and Walker type units in your army may purchase Grav-Chute wargear for 10pts.
- Tauros units may purchase Grav-Chutes for 10pts.
- Master of the Fleet units do not take up a Force Organization Slot.

rites_of_war.name: Tempestus Drop Force
rites_of_war.text:
Restrictions

- All units in your army must have the Tempestus Scion Keyword or Auxiliary Troops special rule.
- Your army must include at least 1 Storm Trooper Section.
- Your army must include at least 1 Command Section.

Benefit

- Ignore the Auxiliary Troops special rule.
- You may field Storm Trooper Sections as Troops choices.
- Valkyrie Dropships gain the Tempestus Scion Keyword and may be fielded as Dedicated Transports.
- You may replace Company Command Squads with Scion Command Squads in any Command Section you include in your army.
- You may replace Veteran Squads with Tempestus Scion Squads in any Command Section you include in your army.
